name: CYPHER Learning
description_en:
CYPHER Learning is a training platform combining course delivery, assessments, automation, skills development and AI-assisted creation. It serves internal training and extended-enterprise audiences such as customers and partners.

Its current pricing separates Enhanced and Enterprise, with organizational complexity and integration controls as important differences. Third-party content and AI consumption should be evaluated separately from the LMS subscription.
description_zh:
CYPHER Learning 是结合课程交付、考核、自动化、技能发展和 AI 辅助创作的培训平台，面向内部培训及客户、合作伙伴等扩展企业人群。

当前套餐区分 Enhanced 与 Enterprise，组织复杂度和集成控制是重要差别。第三方内容与 AI 消耗需与 LMS 订阅分别评估。

core_features.explanation_en: Create paths, assess learning and track skills or certification progress.
core_features.explanation_zh: 创建路径、考核学习并跟踪技能或认证进展。

core_features.explanation_en: Enterprise describes separate sites, portals and API settings by organization.
core_features.explanation_zh: Enterprise 介绍按组织区分站点、门户和 API 设置。

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_zh: 培训交付、技能与自动化
sections.en: The official catalog describes course development, assessments, gamification, learning paths, compliance and skills management. The pricing grid includes SCORM 1.2/2004, AICC and LTI integration, but explicitly marks the xAPI content player as coming soon. Do not turn a roadmap entry into a currently available capability. CYPHER Agent is an AI product capability, not a replacement for checking course accuracy.
sections.zh: 官方目录介绍创课、考核、游戏化、学习路径、合规及技能管理。套餐表包含 SCORM 1.2/2004、AICC 和 LTI 接入，但明确把 xAPI 内容播放器标为即将提供，不能把路线图当现有能力。CYPHER Agent 是 AI 能力，并不替代课程准确性检查。

sections.title_zh: 示例：合作伙伴产品认证
sections.en: Create a product course, attach an assessment and assign it to a pilot partner audience. Check that a failing learner cannot appear certified merely by opening the course, and that a retake produces the intended evidence. For several partner organizations, pilot tenant separation and administrator reporting before importing the full population. These are proposed acceptance cases, not measured CYPHER outcomes.
sections.zh: 创建产品课程和考核，分配给试点合作伙伴。检查未通过学员不会仅因打开课程就显示认证，并确认重考生成预期证据。存在多个伙伴组织时，应先试点租户隔离和管理报告，再导入全部人员。本例是建议验收场景，并非实测结果。

sections.title_en: Quote Enhanced and Enterprise against actual needs
sections.title_zh: 按实际需求询价 Enhanced 和 Enterprise
sections.en: Both plans use a pricing inquiry rather than a published cash amount. Enterprise highlights independent organization sites, organization-specific APIs and portals, and Workato integration. The table lists 100 AI credits per user per year and separately mentions additional credits; third-party content integrations say content is not included. Ask what counts as a learner and how AI, integrations, content packages and services affect the quote.
sections.zh: 两个方案均需询价，没有公开现金金额。Enterprise 强调独立组织站点、按组织配置的 API 与门户及 Workato 接入。表格列每名用户每年 100 AI credits，并另提额外 credits；第三方内容集成注明内容不包含。需确认学员定义，以及 AI、集成、内容包和服务如何影响报价。

sections.title_en: Separate platform automation from learning quality
sections.title_zh: 区分平台自动化与学习质量
sections.en: Begin with course owners, identity rules and completion criteria, then pilot one course and reporting path. Automation can assign or organize work, but cannot establish that an assessment measures the intended skill. CYPHER is relevant to repeatable multi-audience training; exact data-location options, source licensing, backup restoration and contractual support were not verified. Vendor ROI and speed multipliers are not treated as independent evidence.
sections.zh: 先确定课程负责人、身份规则和完成条件，再试点一门课及报告链路。自动化可以分配或整理工作，却不能证明考核测到了目标技能。需要重复开展多人群培训时可考虑它；数据位置选项、源码许可、备份恢复及合同支持未核实。厂商 ROI 与速度倍数未当作独立证据。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)

research_gaps.en: Verify actual quote, learner meter, AI overage, tenant separation and availability of roadmap features.

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
